entries.message: Feature - Add 90-day Remember me sign-in, PlektVR stop webhook parser, and automatic held tracker rechecks
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Added a Remember me for 90 days checkbox on the sign-in screen that extends browser sessions from 7 days to 90 days while keeping sign-out revocation and user-switching expiry intact

Enabled standard username and current-password autocomplete attributes on the sign-in form so password managers can fill credentials cleanly, and refined sign-in panel heading alignment, spacing, and input height

Added a parser for PlektVR headset stop webhooks that derives watched completion at the 90% threshold and passes through known IMDb, TMDB, and TVDB identifiers alongside season, episode, position, duration, and device fields
Added automatic 6-hour background verification for held Trakt writes alongside Simkl so confirmed watches clear without manual checks

Added a read-only /sync/all-items date_from fallback when Simkl /sync/watched reports an episode as unwatched, confirming episodes Simkl filed into a secondary watch-through record when the timestamp matches to the second
Closed unsent Trakt intents immediately when dispatch skips them for missing IDs or policy, cleaned up previously leaked unsent skipped rows, and labelled unsent Trakt holds accurately
Updated the Watch updates on hold panel copy to note automatic 6-hour rechecks for both Trakt and Simkl
